Author: Janssen et al. (2023)
Title: The effect of background noise and its removal on the analysis of single-cell expression data
Key_Results: *CellBender* performs best overall; *DecontX* can affect fine structure in datasets; *SoupX* struggles with datasets dominated by a single cell type

Author: Cargnelli, Nielsen & Madsen (2026)
Title: Benchmarking computational decontamination of ambient RNA
Tools Tested: CellBender; CellClear;DecontX; FastCAR; scAR; SoupX; scCDC
Ground Truth Approach: Genetic information; Simulated data; Negative control data
Key_Results: Choice of tool is dataset-dependent, and also depends on compute availability; *CellBender*, *SoupX* and *DecontX* are the best performing tools overall; Ambient correction does not always improve results as biological signal can be lost

Author: Schroeder, Gerber & Ruffini (2026)
Title: Benchmarking ambient RNA removal across droplet and well-plate platforms reveals artificial count generation as a critical failure mode of scAR and CellClear
Data_Types_Considered: Droplet-based scRNA-seq; Droplet-based snRNA-seq; Well-plate-based scRNA-seq
Ground Truth Approach: Genetic information; Known marker genes and cell types
Key_Results: *scAR* and *CellClear* can cause artificial count inflation in data and are thus advised against; *DecontX* is recommended if empty droplets cannot be provided as input or for well-plate-based data; *CellBender* is recommended if strong compute is available; *SoupX* is recommended for efficiency

Author: Nie et al. (2026)
Title: Systematic benchmarking of ambient RNA decontamination tools to advance precision in single-cell transcriptomic analysis
Tools Tested: CellBender; CellClear;DecontX; FastCAR; scAR; SoupX; scCDC
Ground Truth Approach: Genetic information; Known marker genes and cell types; Simulated data
Key_Results: Best choice of tools is dataset-dependent; *DecontX* has best ambient estimation performance; *scAR* is best at maximising cell type marker gene specificity; For ambient correction within cellular subtypes, *SoupX* is recommended for use first to estimate contamination levels followed by *CellBender* or *CellClear* to perform the decontamination itself
